response.rationale: Early postural instability with repeated falls, progressive rigid-akinetic syndrome, frontal cognitive/behavioral changes, and emotional lability best match PSP; diffuse white matter changes are nonspecific and the other candidates lack key defining features.

rejected.why: No ventriculomegaly or classic NPH triad; diffuse white matter hyperintensity is not typical.
No autonomic dysfunction or cerebellar ataxia; MSA is not supported.
Prominent early gait disorder and rigid-akinetic syndrome are more consistent with PSP than FTD; memory impairment and psychosis are less specific.
